leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Define TypeScript interfaces to structure token data with properties for access and refresh tokens
Implement useState hooks to manage token state and loading status in a React component
Apply conditional rendering to display loading indicators while tokens are being refreshed
Construct API service functions using fetch to request new tokens from a secure endpoint
Execute error handling with try-catch blocks to manage failed token refresh attempts
Utilize useEffect hooks to trigger token refresh operations based on authentication state
Store tokens securely in browser storage and retrieve them for API requests
Control component behavior by comparing token expiration timestamps with current time
Invoke token refresh functions when existing tokens approach their expiration time
Modify HTTP request headers to include refreshed access tokens for authenticated API calls
Implement token validation logic to check token integrity before accepting new tokens
Return appropriate error states and user feedback when token rotation fails
